newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shopping biggest draw for Singapore visitors.
newsitem.headline: Shopping biggest draw for Singapore visitors.

text.p: Shopping is the biggest attraction for visitors to Singapore, a survey by the Singapore Tourist Promotion Board (STPB) showed on Tuesday.

Eighty-four percent of foreign visitors ranked shopping as one of their top activities in Singapore and they spent an estimated S$3.0 billion (US$2.1 billion) on it, according to the STPB's annual Survey of Overseas Visitors.
The survey, conducted throughout 1996, said visitors spent about S$1.0 billion on accommodation and about S$520 million on food and drinks.
Visitors said they were also attracted by Singapore's reputation as a safe and stable, clean and green city.
